'''L3-E7 Colossus''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] four Colossus droids were used to defend the approach to the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]] in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], but were destroyed during the assault by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
L3-E7 Colossus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as "Imperial Colossus Droid" during the Trooper class mission on Corellia, the designation L3-E7 appears only in game files. The droids appear in one of three possible approach routes and, depending on the player's choices, can be destroyed by the [[Fifty-third Armored Platoon]], the [[Eighty-first Infantry]] or by [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
